proposals.evidence: Turner’s first haridrā branch includes Prakrit haladdā/haliddā, Hindi haladdī/haldī, Gujarati haḷad/haḷdar and Marathi haḷad. The retained l/ḷ plus retroflex-stop survey forms and contracted Gujari hād fit that turmeric series; vowel and aspiration variation is preserved. The hāridra dyed-with-turmeric subsection is not selected.
